## About Me

I am a Master of Science in Digital Marketing student at Cal Poly Pomona with a background in marketing management, paid media, analytics, and entertainment marketing. I enjoy turning customer behavior and campaign data into clear recommendations that help organizations make better decisions.

My career goal is to work in entertainment, where I can combine creative storytelling with measurement, audience insights, and digital performance optimization.

::: callout-note
### What I bring

I connect creative ideas with measurable outcomes. My work focuses on understanding the audience, selecting meaningful KPIs, and communicating insights in a way that stakeholders can act on.
:::

## Career Aspirations

-   Build data-informed digital campaigns for entertainment and lifestyle brands.
-   Develop expertise in paid media, audience strategy, and marketing analytics.
-   Create inclusive and engaging brand experiences across social, search, and owned channels.
